sources.title: Zeros of Jensen polynomials and asymptotics for the Riemann xi function
sources.author: Cormac O'Sullivan
claims_verified: xi is entire of order 1 and satisfies xi(1-s)=xi(s)
RH is equivalent to Theta having only negative real zeros
Theta Taylor coefficients satisfy gamma(m)=m!/(2m)! * xi^(2m)(1/2)
RH is equivalent to hyperbolicity of all associated Jensen polynomials

sources.title: Moment-sequence transforms
claims_verified: Theorem 2.2 restates the classical Hamburger-Stieltjes-Hausdorff correspondence
a real sequence is a moment sequence on R iff its Hankel matrix is positive semidefinite
for support on [0,infinity), positivity of the Hankel matrix together with the shifted/truncated Hankel positivity characterizes the Stieltjes moment case

sources.title: Jensen Polynomials for the Riemann Xi Function
claims_verified: Polya's Jensen-polynomial hyperbolicity criterion is equivalent to RH
large families of Jensen polynomials are proved hyperbolic in explicit/asymptotic regimes

sources.title: Jensen polynomials are not a plausible route to proving the Riemann Hypothesis
sources.author: David W. Farmer
claims_verified: asymptotic Jensen hyperbolicity phenomena alone should not be promoted as evidence of a viable RH proof route
sources.m_minus_role: guards against treating universal/asymptotic Hermite attraction as a proof mechanism
